description: This file defines a class `JsonTestDataProvider` within the namespace `OrangeHRM\Tests\Util\DataProvider`. The class provides static methods to load and decode JSON files and extract test case data, primarily for use in PHPUnit tests. The methods include validation to ensure the JSON content conforms to expected structure, avoiding dependence on heavy JSON schema validation.

classes.name: JsonTestDataProvider
classes.description: A utility class for loading JSON test data files and extracting test case data for PHPUnit tests.

methods.name: loadJson
methods.description: Static method to load, read, and decode a JSON file into an associative array with validation.

methods.name: getCases
methods.description: Static method to extract and validate an array of test cases from decoded JSON content.
